title: Weird experience
content: I was on a date in mall world with Leonardo DiCaprio and I was different everything that I’m insecure about went away I looked just how I dreamed of looking I was wearing a yellow dress we were sitting out side it was late it looked like 8 pm around and I sat in his lap and told how beautiful I was then I started morphing back to myself not beautiful with a dress I was wearing no clothes I was trying to cover up my body until a whole bunch of reptillions told me how ugly and fat I was I’m super insecure about my weight and they pointed out everything I was insecure about and I couldn’t help but cry then I woke up
